---
title: "Add Comprehensive Date-Based Attributes to a DBI  lazy frame or tibble object"
pagetitle: "Add Comprehensive Date-Based Attributes to a DBI  lazy frame or tibble object — augment_standard_calendar"
---

::: {.qrtdown-source .dont-index}
Source: [`R/utils-misc.R`](https://codeberg.org/usrbinr/ti/src/branch/main/R/utils-misc.R)
:::

<p>This function takes a data frame and a date column and generates a wide set of
derived date attributes. These include start/end dates for year, quarter,
month, and week; day-of-week indicators; completed and remaining days in each
time unit; and additional convenience variables such as weekend indicators.
</p>
<p>It is designed for time-based feature engineering and is useful in reporting,
forecasting, time-series modeling, and data enrichment workflows.
</p>

## Usage

```r
augment_standard_calendar(.data, .date)
```

## Arguments

<dl class="qrtdown-arguments">
<dt id="arg-data"><code>.data</code><a class="anchor" aria-label="anchor" href="#arg-data"></a></dt>
<dd><p>A data frame or tibble containing at least one date column.</p></dd>
<dt id="arg-date"><code>.date</code><a class="anchor" aria-label="anchor" href="#arg-date"></a></dt>
<dd><p>A column containing <code>Date</code> values, passed using tidy-eval
(e.g., <code>{{ date_col }}</code>).</p></dd>
</dl>

## Value

<p>A dbi or  tibble containing the original data along with all generated
date-based attributes.
</p>

## Details

<p>The function creates the following groups of attributes:
</p>
<p><strong>1. Start and end dates</strong>
</p>
<ul>
<li> <p><code>year_start_date</code>, <code>year_end_date</code>
</p>
</li>
<li> <p><code>quarter_start_date</code>, <code>quarter_end_date</code>
</p>
</li>
<li> <p><code>month_start_date</code>, <code>month_end_date</code>
</p>
</li>
<li> <p><code>week_start_date</code>, <code>week_end_date</code>
</p>
</li>
</ul>

<p><strong>2. Day-of-week fields</strong>
</p>
<ul>
<li> <p><code>day_of_week</code> – numeric day of the week (1–7)
</p>
</li>
<li> <p><code>day_of_week_label</code> – ordered factor label (e.g., Mon, Tue, …)
</p>
</li>
</ul>

<p><strong>3. Duration fields</strong>
</p>
<ul>
<li> <p><code>days_in_year</code> – total days in the year interval
</p>
</li>
<li> <p><code>days_in_quarter</code> – total days in the quarter interval
</p>
</li>
<li> <p><code>days_in_month</code> – total days in the month
</p>
</li>
</ul>

<p><strong>4. Completed/remaining days</strong>
</p>
<ul>
<li> <p><code>days_complete_in_week</code>, <code>days_remaining_in_week</code>
</p>
</li>
<li> <p><code>days_complete_in_month</code>, <code>days_remaining_in_month</code>
</p>
</li>
<li> <p><code>days_complete_in_quarter</code>, <code>days_remaining_in_quarter</code>
</p>
</li>
<li> <p><code>days_complete_in_year</code>, <code>days_remaining_in_year</code>
</p>
</li>
</ul>

<p><strong>5. Miscellaneous</strong>
</p>
<ul><li> <p><code>weekend_indicator</code> – equals 1 if Saturday or Sunday; otherwise 0
</p>
</li></ul>

<p>All date-derived fields ending in <code style="white-space: pre;">⁠_date⁠</code> are coerced to class <code>Date</code>.
</p>
